name: RSI RFTL EA
summary: This EA uses the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator combined with RFTL (Recursive Fast Trend Line) to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when RSI is oversold and the RFTL confirms an upward trend, and enters short positions when RSI is overbought and RFTL confirms a downward trend. The strategy aims to capture momentum reversals filtered by a trend-confirmation digital filter.
summary_zh: 该EA使用RSI（相对强弱指数）指标结合RFTL（递归快速趋势线）来生成交易信号。当RSI超卖且RFTL确认上升趋势时做多，当RSI超买且RFTL确认下降趋势时做空。该策略旨在通过趋势确认数字滤波器来捕捉动量反转。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于RSI动量反转与RFTL趋势方向过滤的双重确认机制。入场条件为：做多时RSI低于超卖阈值且RFTL值为正（上升趋势确认），做空时RSI高于超买阈值且RFTL值为负（下降趋势确认）。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈止损，或当RSI回到中性区域时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未见到动态仓位调整或基于账户权益的计算方式。资金管理方面，EA依赖用户手动设置手数，缺乏自动风险比例计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺乏对市场波动性和点差的适应性处理。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation mechanism combining RSI momentum reversal with RFTL trend direction filtering. Entry conditions are: go long when RSI is below the oversold threshold and RFTL value is positive (confirming uptrend), go short when RSI is above the overbought threshold and RFTL value is negative (confirming downtrend). Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when RSI returns to the neutral zone. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic lot calculation or equity-based sizing. Money management relies on the user manually setting the lot size, lacking automatic risk-per-trade calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks adaptability to market volatility and spread considerations.

parameters.name: RSI_Oversold
parameters.description: RSI超卖阈值，低于此值考虑做多
parameters.description_en: RSI oversold threshold; consider long below this

parameters.name: RSI_Overbought
parameters.description: RSI超买阈值，高于此值考虑做空
parameters.description_en: RSI overbought threshold; consider short above this

pros: 双指标确认机制减少虚假信号，RSI与RFTL互补提高信号可靠性
策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和参数优化
RFTL作为数字滤波器能有效过滤市场噪音，提供平滑的趋势判断
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals; RSI and RFTL complement each other to improve signal reliability
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize parameters
RFTL as a digital filter effectively removes market noise and provides smooth trend identification
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整交易规模
未包含点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损
RSI在强趋势市场中容易产生持续超买超卖信号，导致过早逆势入场
cons_en: Fixed lot size lacks dynamic position management, unable to automatically adjust trade size based on account risk
No spread filter mechanism included, which may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
RSI can produce persistent overbought/oversold signals in strong trending markets, leading to premature counter-trend entries
improvements: 增加基于账户权益百分比的风险计算，实现动态仓位管理
添加点差过滤和时间过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add equity-percentage-based risk calculation for dynamic position sizing
Add spread filter and session filter to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 固定手数不随账户余额变化，可能导致过度交易或风险不足
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not scale with account balance, potentially leading to overtrading or insufficient risk
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
